occurrence_sentence: "Harnessing the power of science-driven entrepreneurship is the quickest way to tackle urgent global problems, and thus we need more ways to accelerate science-based innovation. We want to challenge research teams to build scalable solutions for urgent issues and look forward to supporting the best ideas, helping them scale," says Inka Mero, Founding Partner of Voima Ventures.
